correctness.rationale: Every exterior infection front has Erlang time of shape L or R at rate lambda; two active interior fronts give Erlang shape M at rate 2lambda, and the three disjoint edge-clock families are independent, proving Q_L(s)Q_R(s)Q_M(2s). Strict Poisson-tail log-concavity makes each marginal sequence strictly decreasing, so prefix selection by the three-way merge is globally optimal. At endpoints the weakest retained interior marginal is ell_N(2s), yielding the exact comparison with ell_1(s). H_N(s)=sum s^k/k! (2^k k!/(N)_k-1) has one negative-to-positive sign change for N>=3; H_N(s)/s^m increases to a positive limit/infinity, proving exactly one positive threshold. Independently checked 40 all-pair finite n/s instances.
